_README: Hard thresholds — the reasons an application is rejected before anyone
reads it. They are knowable the moment a job is added, so they are checked
then, not after the documents are written.
A hit never removes a job. It marks it and sorts it to the top of the
'To assess' group with a reason, exactly as fit.py scores a visa-blocked
role down instead of hiding it. The judgement stays with you: an employer
who says 'registration required' sometimes means 'or eligible for'.
Add your own patterns. They are case-insensitive regular expressions,
matched against the whole ad text.

citizenship.label: Citizenship or permanent residency
citizenship.why: This ad appears to require citizenship or PR, which a visa holder cannot meet.

clearance.label: Security clearance
clearance.why: An AGSVA clearance requires Australian citizenship, so this is closed to visa holders.
patterns: ability to obtain( and maintain)? a .{0,20}clearance

registration.label: Professional registration
registration.why: This role needs a registration or licence that takes time to obtain and cannot be assumed.

experience_years.label: Minimum years of experience
experience_years.why: A stated minimum number of years in a specific role is a filter applied before merit.

location.label: Location
location.why: This role names a location that may sit outside where you are permitted or able to work.
